title: Naturality of the prescribed strict pullback tower
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme morphism f:X→Y in the same universe. Use the ordinary coherent reduction, sequence inverse image, simultaneous restriction and strict finite pullback towers of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core]. The chosen strict tower isomorphism pullbackTensorPullbackTower(P), whose every component is the prescribed reordering, pullback evaluation and inverse reduction evaluation, is natural in every chain map P→Q of arbitrary unbounded completed-module cochain complexes. Thus the square comparing the restricted, reordered sequence pullback/reduction map with the actual finite-pullback tower map commutes.

proof.text: Evaluate the proposed square at n. The tower normalization identifies its two comparison components with reordering, pullback evaluation and inverse reduction evaluation. These three factors form natural isomorphisms of cochain functors; paste their naturality squares. Replace the prescribed level components by the normalized tower components. Extensionality of natural transformations gives the tower equality.

theorem pullbackTensorPullbackTower_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ} (g : P ⟶ Q) :
    HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
            (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map g))) ≫
      (pullbackTensorPullbackTower l E f Q).hom =
    (pullbackTensorPullbackTower l E f P).hom ≫
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).map g
